title: A Moment in Flight
description: A short-eared owl (Asio flammeus) flies over the salt marshes of British Columbia’s Fraser River Delta at dusk. These owls fly low and slow as they hunt, relying primarily on acute hearing to drop down on prey hidden under grass coves.
translated_description: 一只短耳鸮（学名：Asio flammeus）在黄昏时分飞过加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省弗雷泽河三角洲的盐沼。这种猫头鹰捕猎时飞得又低又慢，主要依靠敏锐的听觉俯冲扑向隐藏在草丛下的猎物。
